points.description: States that selection sort works through the array one element/position at a time, from left to right (or repeatedly advances the current position).
States that at each step it finds/selects the minimum (smallest) element among the remaining unsorted elements to the right of the current position.
States that it swaps (or exchanges) that minimum element with the current element, placing the minimum in its correct position.

rubric.notes: Full marks require all three ideas: moving through the array position by position, selecting the minimum of the remaining elements, and swapping it with the current element. Award the relevant point(s) for equivalent wording; do not award P2 for merely saying 'finds a small element' without identifying the minimum of the remaining elements. No marks for describing a different sorting algorithm or only saying 'it sorts by selecting' without the minimum/swap process.
